retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle portrait of a performer set against a black background, featuring a bold diagonal graphic element that anchors retro-styled block typography.
triggerTerms: low angle performer portrait against black

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a central figure in a vibrant patterned shirt, framed by a thick, multi-toned diagonal stripe that serves as a platform for heavy, stylized typography in the upper left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal graphic leads the eye from the text to the subject's torso.
The warm orange tones of the graphic and shirt contrast sharply with the deep black background.
The low-angle perspective creates a sense of presence and elevation for the subject.
coreInvariants: Diagonal graphic element with a 45-degree inclination

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick diagonal orange graphic in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold text, follows the diagonal down to the subject's hands, then up to the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black space on the left and right margins.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Orange and Burnt Sienna (Graphic and Shirt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the oranges against zero-saturation black.

letterConstructionRules: Rounded outer corners on specific glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'u' used as a stylistic variant in titles
Circular dots for punctuation and 'i' titles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights and cases.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and verticality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle portrait of a man in a patterned orange/red shirt against a solid black background, leaving the upper left quadrant clear for graphics.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thick diagonal orange stripe from the top left corner towards the center. Place bold, square, orange-filled text with white outlines on top of the stripe.

verificationChecks: Does the diagonal graphic have a distinct 3D-like shadow effect?
Is the text extremely bold and tightly spaced?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Clean vector edges on the graphic

postGenerationChecks: Check that the diagonal graphic does not obscure the subject's face.
Ensure the white outline on the text is thin and crisp.
Verify the shirt pattern is repetitive and geometric.
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Low Angle) + Background(Solid Black) + Graphic(Diagonal Stripe) + Type(Bold Geometric Square)
